# openai_workload_identity_provider (Data Source)

Retrieve a workload identity provider.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_workload_identity_provider" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) workload identity provider id

### Read-Only

- `attribute_transformations` (Attributes List) Attribute expressions evaluated against the incoming identity. Removing the configuration clears the transformations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_transformations))
- `audience` (String) audience
- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `description` (String) description
- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled
- `id` (String) id
- `issuer` (String) issuer
- `name` (String) name
- `type` (String) type
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `verification` (Attributes) OIDC verification configuration. Use discovery with an optional discovery_url, or uploaded_jwks with a public JWKS object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_transformations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_transformations`

Read-Only:

- `attribute` (String) attribute
- `expression` (String) expression


<a id="nestedatt--verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification`

Read-Only:

- `discovery_url` (String) discovery url
- `jwks` (Dynamic) Public JSON Web Key Set. Do not include private keys.
- `type` (String) type
